uncited: It distinguishes itself from sibling methods by its direct use of CUDA kernels for parallel triangle processing and atomic memory updates, contrasting with CPU parallelization [7135-parallel-cpu-voxelization.md] or specialized structures like linked lists [1187-per-pixel-linked-list-voxelization.md].
The method is based on the algorithm described by Schwarz and Seidel [6757-cuda-voxelizer-gpu-voxelization.md].
It was implemented as a high-performance, real-time solution leveraging CUDA parallelism [6757-cuda-voxelizer-gpu-voxelization.md].
